init_distributed: initialize distributed training by calling init() to set up rank and world size across GPUs
average_metrics: average metrics across all distributed processes using the average() function with optional count weighting
wrap_model: wrap a PyTorch model with DistributedDataParallel for multi-GPU training using the wrap() function
barrier_sync: synchronize all distributed processes at a barrier point using the barrier() function
share_object: broadcast a pickled Python object from one process to all others using the share() function
